gist: WhatsApp messages, voice/video calls, groups aur Status ke liye hai. Chats tab mein guftagu, Status mein 24 ghante wali posts, Channels mein broadcasts aur Communities mein bare groups milte hain. Settings profile photo wale menu (upar teen dots ya neeche Settings tab) se khulti hai.

options.desc: Pages aur brands ke one-way updates follow karne ki jagah.
